extName.description: Extension name. Keep 'YouTube' after the product name (trademark guidelines).

extDescription.message: Shows how many times you have watched each video. Your history stays on your device.
extDescription.description: Extension description in the Chrome Web Store, max 132 characters.

viewsOne.description: Badge under the video, plural form 'one'.

viewsFew.description: Badge under the video, plural form 'few'.

viewsMany.description: Badge under the video, plural form 'many'.

viewsOther.description: Badge under the video, plural form 'other'.

cardViews.description: The user's view count, shown in parentheses: on video cards (home page, recommendations), and under the video when it has not been watched yet (count 0).

tooltipNone.message: You haven't watched this video yet
tooltipNone.description: Tooltip on the badge when the video has no views yet.

tooltipDates.description: Tooltip on the badge with the first and last view dates.

tooltipImported.message: Counted by the extension: $COUNTED$, from Google Takeout: $IMPORTED$
tooltipImported.description: Tooltip line when some views were imported from Takeout.

statsEmpty.message: No views yet. Watch a video for a few seconds, or import your history from Google Takeout on the Data tab.

settingShowZero.message: Show the counter for unwatched videos

settingsNote.message: Settings apply right away and sync with your browser profile. Your view history stays on this device.

backupText.message: Save your history to a file to keep it safe or move it to another browser. Restoring adds to the current history and never doubles counts.

takeoutStep1.message: Open takeout.google.com, click "Deselect all" and select "YouTube and YouTube Music".

takeoutStep2.message: In "Multiple formats" choose JSON for history, and in "All YouTube data included" keep only history.

takeoutStep3.message: Download the archive and choose the file watch-history.json from its history folder here.

takeoutNote.message: Only views before $DATE$ are imported: later ones the extension counts itself. A new import replaces the previous one.

importTakeoutDone.message: Imported $VIEWS$ views of $VIDEOS$ videos. Views after counting started, left out: $AFTER$.

clearText.message: Deletes all views, including imported ones. Counting starts over. Save a backup first if you may need it.

errorNotBackup.message: This file is not a Local Views backup.

errorNewerVersion.message: This backup was made by a newer version of the extension. Update it first.

errorNotTakeout.message: This file is not a YouTube watch history from Google Takeout. Choose watch-history.json exported as JSON.
